lines.text: First time down the Stair? Walk to the end. Everybody does.
Keep walking, the stage is full.

barks.text: A tram goes over somewhere above the roofs. The puddles shiver.
Everyone walks to the end eventually. That's where the Halo is.
Past Spare Parts, then the street gives up. That's your Halo.
Music from every door and I can't name one song.
Somebody's lease ran out tonight. You can tell by how they're buying.
Keep your hands where Sable can count them.
I only came down for one.
